approved: Biosecurity (Consequential Amendments and Transitional Provisions) Bill 2014

Introduced the Biosecurity (Consequential Amendments and Transitional Provisions) Bill 2014, explaining it will make minor amendments to more than 20 pieces of Commonwealth legislation and repeal the Quarantine Act and the Quarantine Charges (Collection) Act 2014 to ensure a smooth transition to the new Biosecurity Act.

Summed up the Biosecurity Bill debate, noting the Quarantine Act has been amended more than 50 times over 106 years and Australia's agricultural production was worth $53 billion in 2013 to 2014, and assured the House the Inspector-General of Biosecurity position and its funding, currently held by Dr Michael Bond, will continue.
